entities.summary: Ramón Clemente is a Puerto Rican former professional basketball player, who spent the majority of his career in the Baloncesto Superior Nacional (BSN), most notably for the Indios de Mayagüez, Vaqueros de Bayamón, and Cangrejeros de Santurce.
